findings.title: Homepage loads oversized medallion images
findings.recommendation: Supply optimized image variants at their displayed sizes and reserve stable dimensions.

findings.title: Startup layout shifts in guide and Craft
findings.recommendation: Inspect startup sources and initialize the route and shell before a visible intermediate layout. Retain no-JavaScript reading.

findings.title: Search oracle is coupled to alias construction
findings.recommendation: Freeze independently judged exact destinations. Correct capacity and authority/provenance bindings.

findings.title: Natural questions miss existing topics
findings.recommendation: Improve tokenization and comparison queries; retain an independent untuned query set.

findings.title: Robot series is outside shared navigation and search
findings.recommendation: Index all robot essay sections and add shared search and routes back to the site.

findings.title: Skip links change the current topic
findings.recommendation: Preserve the current chapter and focus its visible content before the next Tab.

findings.title: Fit control fails in five map views
findings.recommendation: Separate interactive map sizing from static diagram minimum widths; repeat Fit and zoom checks in every view.

findings.title: Heading and landmark structure needs repair
findings.classification: automated best-practice finding with markup inspection
findings.recommendation: Correct rendered heading ranks, name tables by their subject, distinguish library regions and add a main landmark to the form.

findings.title: Diagram text is small relative to reading text
findings.recommendation: Increase label size with matching layout changes; retain larger inspector text and relationship lists.

findings.title: Availability and practical next actions are hard to find
findings.recommendation: Offer a current-scope route near the primary entrance and an exact intended source/contribution destination.

findings.title: Reference document has high parsing and browsing cost
findings.recommendation: Evaluate smaller static catalog or record pages while preserving exact bodies, direct links and offline search.

findings.title: Page families have different routes home
findings.recommendation: Provide a predictable route to the homepage and research from every reading surface.

findings.title: Guide alias duplicates the canonical content
findings.recommendation: Redirect or select a canonical route while preserving deep links.

findings.title: Speculative lesson branch adds reading effort
findings.recommendation: Label the later hypothetical branch and observe whether readers confuse advice with established cause.
